answer: The quartz panel is drawn blind, the ember escrow settles at close, and ledge lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 7% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 312 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
